title: What If a Zombie Apocalypse Started and You Only Had 4 Minutes?

shots.line: [04:00] Your phone screams first. Every screen in the city flashes the same four words: DO NOT GO OUTSIDE.
shots.scene: Apartment wide two-shot: YOU and SAM freeze as TV and phones blast crimson EMERGENCY ALERT — 04:00 countdown begins.

shots.line: [03:45] Sirens wail across the skyline. You don't have hours to prepare — you have four minutes.
shots.scene: Giant bigFace close-up of YOU lit by pulsing emergency glow, eyes locking in focus with '03:45' corner countdown.

shots.line: [03:30] What if a zombie apocalypse started right now... and you only had four minutes?
shots.scene: Cinematic city skyline with smoke plumes, searchlight beams, and glowing title card: WHAT IF ZOMBIES STARTED / YOU ONLY HAVE 4 MINUTES.

shots.line: [03:10] Minute One: Outside, gridlock hits in thirty seconds. Infected silhouettes surge down the avenue.
shots.scene: 3D Three.js street orbit: lit apartment blocks, streetlamps, and a horde of shambling zombie figures advancing up the avenue.

shots.line: [02:45] One bite takes twenty seconds to turn. By minute four, one case becomes four thousand.
shots.scene: Blueprint exponential outbreak data card: INFECTION CURVE climbing steeply from 1 to 4,096 cases in 4.0 min.

shots.line: [02:15] Minute Two: Ignore weapons — grab water. Pressure drops the moment power plants go unmanned.
shots.scene: Macro kitchen sink insert: YOU with speed-trail arms filling every bottle and pot under a blasting faucet ('02:15 — FILL WATER FIRST').

shots.line: [01:45] Heavy footsteps hit your hallway. You and Sam slam the couch straight into the front door.
shots.scene: Dynamic hallway action two-shot: YOU and SAM brace a heavy sofa against the rattling apartment door as dust flies ('01:45').

shots.line: [01:15] Minute Three: Kill every light and sound. One lit window in a dark block is a dinner bell.
shots.scene: Blueprint + silhouette diagram: SOUND & LIGHT = BAIT — breaker switch flips OFF as soundwave rings pass harmlessly outside ('01:15').

shots.line: [00:45] Never take the ground stairs — everyone runs down. You climb up toward the roof hatch.
shots.scene: Vertical split/cutaway stairwell: zombie silhouettes swarming the lower stairs ('GROUND = TRAP') while YOU and SAM climb the roof ladder ('GO UP').

shots.line: [00:15] Fifteen seconds left! The hallway door splinters — time freezes as you haul Sam through the hatch!
shots.scene: SIGNATURE TIME-STOP: Frozen wood splinters and floating droplets in blue-crimson tint as zombie hands breach below; '00:15' badge.

shots.line: [00:00] Zero hour. The steel hatch locks behind you as sirens echo across the burning city.
shots.scene: Epic rooftop wide shot: YOU and SAM silhouetted on the roof against searchlights and dusk sky as countdown hits '00:00 — SURVIVED'.

shots.line: Four minutes. What are the first three things YOU grab? Tell us in the comments and subscribe.
shots.scene: End screen: 'What would YOU grab in 4 minutes?' in serif italic, comment bubble, Subscribe pill, YOU, SAM, and two shambling zombies.
